Subject: Re: Crestline DPA & SCCs redline for review

Rachel / Marissa — I've reviewed Crestline's DPA redline and SCCs Annex. High-level observations and suggested text included in the attached RI_DPA_suggested_edits_20260913.docx. Summary below:

1) Roles table (Clause 2): we should accept Controller/Processor split as proposed but need a short representation of controller obligations for data subject requests — suggested language: "Provider will reasonably assist Controller in fulfilling AD requests within 14 calendar days where operationally possible."

2) KMS (Clause 7): Crestline's request for customer-managed keys is operationally feasible for Dedicated customers only. Proposed compromise: a) Hosted: provider-managed KMS with key export restrictions + BYOK as add-on; b) Dedicated/Private: full BYOK. I've inserted conditional language.

3) SCCs Annex B: Crestline's variant requires explicit subprocessor disclosure frequency (they ask for 30 days notice). We can commit to 30 days for material subprocessor changes; for minor infra rotations we propose a 14-day notice.

4) Transfer-impact addendum: two highlighted subprocessor carveouts (PaymentsPro and EdgeStore CDN) may trigger a limited transfer-impact addendum. We should request evidence from Crestline on where those services process EU data.

Open asks for Crestline legal: please confirm (a) whether backups to non-EU are permitted (yes/no) and (b) whether they require contractual audit rights over our infra subprocessor providers.

I'll plan a short review call if they want clause-level walkthroughs.

Attachments: RI_DPA_suggested_edits_20260913.docx, SCCs_compatibility_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Karthik / Rachel — thanks for the quick pass. A couple quick responses from Crestline counsel:
- Backups: Crestline requires that persistent backups of production datasets remain within EU borders; ephemeral logs/metrics may be routed outside EU if pseudonymized.
- Audit rights: Crestline is willing to accept SOC2 + evidence package for infra providers; contractual audit rights limited to material subprocessor incidents only.

On KMS: we appreciate the Dedicated/Private BYOK path; can you confirm estimated pricing delta for enabling BYOK on Dedicated? Procurement will need a ballpark for the PO.

I've uploaded a redline with minor concessions and a short note: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefG-crestline-dpa (see file SCCs_AnnexB_v2.pdf).

Proposed next step: 30-minute call Monday to finalize open bullets and then DocuSign circulation. Available Monday 10:00–11:00 and 15:00–16:00 CET.
